summary: The study investigates the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of Al2O3 on InSb substrates with or without surface pretreatments. The process uses trimethylaluminum (TMA) as a metal precursor. Two surface pretreatments are introduced: an in situ TMA/Ar purge and ex situ CP4A chemical etching. These pretreatments help remove native oxides from InSb, leading to a native-oxides-free Al2O3/InSb structure. The study also evaluates the insulative and interface quality of the resulting Pt/Al2O3/InSb metal-oxide-semiconductor (MOS) structure.

The deposition temperature was carried out at 200°C to meet the low process temperature requirement for InSb. The main precursors used are trimethylaluminum (TMA).
